title: 第19章 少女的挑战第20章 孟晶
content_zh:
江平安看出了对方有点错愕。
“你们救我是为了对付萍水县士兵，他们逼死我父母，我想杀他们，大家目标一致。”
孟阔恍然大悟，原来如此，怪不得直接答应了。
“你想要什么，总要开出点条件。”
为了更好地拉拢人心，必须给好处，要想马儿跑，就要给马儿吃草。
江平安沉思片刻，“你有没有让死人复活的办法。”
孟阔眸子闪烁两下，猜到了什么，目光变得柔和，“抱歉，世上没人能让死人复活。”
“成仙呢？”江平安又问道。
“成仙？”
成仙谈何容易，世人至今在寻找成仙之路，可又有几人能成功？
孟阔不太忍心打击这个少年，但有些事情还是要说。
“成仙太难了，需要跨过练气，成就筑基，铸就金丹，诞生元婴，抗住天劫……这世间已经很久没有人成仙了。”
“很久没有人成仙？也就是说，有人成过仙？”江平安眸子中终于出现了光芒。
“有，大夏国开国国主就已飞升仙界，但是这已经过去数不清的岁月，现在几乎听不到成仙的消息了。”
世人都在寻找成仙之路，但不知道为什么，仙路仿佛断了，再无成仙的消息。
听到世间有仙，江平安紧紧握住拳头。
只要成为传说中的仙，一定能复活父母！
孟阔想说什么，但看到少年脸上的坚毅，最终还是闭上了嘴。
少年需要一个梦，等他长大一些，就知道这个梦遥不可及。
“嘭！”

房间门被推开，一个少女闯了进来。
“爹！李爷爷说有个天才比我厉害，我要和他比武！”
江平安看向少女。
对方与他年龄差不多，十四五岁，身穿红白相间的练功服，修长洁白的小腿上绑着黑色绷带，腰间挂着刀，梳着俏马尾，轻轻摆动，洁白干净的小脸上带着傲气和英气。
江平安第一次看到这么漂亮的女孩。
真好看，也不知道虎妞长大后会不会也这么漂亮。
孟晶拔出腰间的刀，指向江平安，抬着小下巴。
“你就是李爷爷说的那个天才？来，咱们比一场。”
“小晶，别胡闹，出去。”孟阔不满开口。
“不要，我就是想看看谁比我天才。”孟晶嘟着小嘴。
孟阔突然把脸拉了下来。
孟晶知道父亲生气了，吐了吐小舌头，快速跑了出去。
孟阔无奈叹气，转头看向江平安，看看人家少年多稳重，再看看自己的女儿，哎~
孟阔拍了一下腰间的储物袋，一个袋子从里面飞了出来。
“以后你就是军营里的人，这里有三百颗血气丹，是你之前击杀三名中队长的悬赏奖励。”
“你是灵修吧，如果不想要血气丹，可以找老李换成灵石。”
“接下来这些天你先修养身体，我会让李老陪你在这里逛逛，之后再正式进入军营。”
“不出意外的话，这个冬天会有一场与萍水县的战争，这一战或许就是决战。”
江平安紧握拳头，他恨不得现在就与对方打起来，给父母报仇。
“还有什么要问的吗？”孟阔问道。
content_en:
Jiang Ping'an saw that the other party was a little surprised.
"You saved me to deal with Pingshui County soldiers. They forced my parents to death. I wanted to kill them. We all have the same goal."
Meng Kuo suddenly realized that this was the case, no wonder he agreed directly.
"Whatever you want, you have to put some conditions on it."
In order to better win over people's hearts, you must give benefits. If you want the horse to run, you must feed the horse.
Jiang Ping'an thought for a moment, "Do you have any way to resurrect the dead?"
Meng Kuo's eyes flickered twice, and he guessed something, and his eyes softened, "I'm sorry, no one in the world can resurrect the dead."
"Where's becoming an immortal?" Jiang Ping'an asked again.
"Become an immortal?"
Becoming an immortal is not easy. People in the world are still looking for the path to becoming an immortal, but how many people can succeed?
Meng Kuo couldn't bear to hit this young man, but he still had some things to say.
"Becoming an immortal is too difficult. You need to go through the steps of practicing Qi, building a foundation, casting a golden elixir, giving birth to a Nascent Soul, and resisting the catastrophe... No one has become an immortal in this world for a long time."
"No one has become an immortal for a long time? In other words, someone has become an immortal?" Jiang Pingan's eyes finally showed light.
"Yes, the founder of the Great Xia Kingdom has ascended to the immortal world, but countless years have passed, and now there is almost no news of becoming an immortal."
Everyone in the world is looking for the path to immortality, but for some unknown reason, the path to immortality seems to have been cut off, and there is no news of immortality.
Hearing that there were immortals in the world, Jiang Pingan clenched his fists tightly.
As long as you become a legendary fairy, you will definitely be able to resurrect your parents!
Meng Kuo wanted to say something, but seeing the determination on the young man's face, he finally shut his mouth.
A young man needs a dream. When he grows older, he will realize that this dream is out of reach.
"Bang!"
The door to the room was pushed open, and a girl broke in.
"Dad! Grandpa Li said there is a genius who is better than me, and I want to compete with him!"
Jiang Pingan looked at the girl.
The other person was about the same age as him, fourteen or fifteen years old. He was wearing red and white training clothes, with a black bandage on his slender white calf, a knife hanging on his waist, and a cute ponytail that was swaying gently. His white and clean face was filled with arrogance and heroism.
Jiang Pingan saw such a beautiful girl for the first time.
It’s so beautiful. I wonder if Hu Niu will be so beautiful when she grows up.
Meng Jing pulled out the knife from her waist, pointed it at Jiang Pingan, and raised her chin.
"Are you the genius that Grandpa Li mentioned? Come, let's compete."
"Xiaojing, stop messing around and get out." Meng Kuo said dissatisfied.
"No, I just want to see who is more talented than me." Meng Jing pouted.
Meng Kuo suddenly pulled his face down.
Meng Jing knew that her father was angry, so she stuck out her tongue and ran out quickly.
Meng Kuo sighed helplessly, turned to look at Jiang Ping'an, and saw how steady the young man was, and then looked at his daughter, ugh~
Meng Kuo patted the storage bag on his waist, and a bag flew out from it.
"From now on, you will be a member of the military camp. There are three hundred blood pills here, which are the rewards for killing three squadron leaders before."
"You are a spiritual practitioner, right? If you don't want the blood pill, you can ask Lao Li to exchange it for the spirit stone."
"You will recuperate in the next few days. I will ask Mr. Li to accompany you around here before officially entering the military camp."
"If nothing else happens, there will be a war with Pingshui County this winter, and this battle may be the decisive battle."
Jiang Ping'an clenched his fists. He wanted to fight with him now to avenge his parents.
"Is there anything else you want to ask?" Meng Kuo asked.
